channel.title: Deep-Learning on Akshat Gupta
channel.description: Recent content in Deep-Learning on Akshat Gupta

item.title: What are Diffusion Models?
item.description: A technical exploration of diffusion models — how the forward/reverse diffusion process works, U-Net architectures, denoising score matching, and why they outperform GANs.

item.title: Hands-on Deep Learning with TensorFlow 2.0
item.description: A practical guide to building deep learning models with TensorFlow 2.0, published by Packt Publishing.

item.title: Evaluating LLMs: How Do You Measure a Model's Mind?
item.description: A practical guide to evaluating large language models — benchmarks, automated metrics, human evaluation, and the pitfalls of measuring model quality.

item.title: Understanding Attention in Transformers: The Core of Modern NLP
item.description: A deep dive into self-attention mechanisms — how they work, why they power modern Transformers, and the different attention variants used in GPT, BERT, and LLaMA.

item.title: Model Extraction Attacks: How Hackers Steal AI Models
item.description: An in-depth look at model extraction attacks — how adversaries replicate ML models through repeated queries, and practical defenses against theft.

item.title: Memories in Large Language Models: How AI Models Remember and Retrieve
item.description: How LLMs manage memory across three time scales — context windows, KV caches, and RAG-based long-term retrieval — and what this means for building AI systems.

item.title: Speaker Anonymization: Protecting Voice Identity in the AI Era
item.description: A deep dive into speaker anonymization — protecting voice identity using voice conversion, signal processing, and deep learning while preserving speech intelligibility.

item.title: LLM Agents: Building AI Systems That Can Reason and Act
item.description: A comprehensive guide to LLM agents — autonomous AI systems that reason, plan, and act. Covers architecture, memory, tool use, and real-world implementation.
